summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests response adaptive ablative pre-operative SPBI (RAPS) radiation and a non-surgical sentinel lymph node check using microbubble contrast ultrasound in early-stage estrogen receptor-positive breast cancer. Radiation is given before surgery, and the number of doses and schedule are not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; the record lists efficacy of pre-operative radiation and whether microbubble contrast ultrasound can replace operative sentinel lymph node biopsy as goals.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 2 evalúa la radiación preoperatoria SPBI adaptativa y ablativa (RAPS) y una revisión no quirúrgica del ganglio centinela con ultrasonido de contraste con microburbujas, en cáncer de mama temprano receptor de estrógeno positivo. La radiación se administra antes de la cirugía; el número de dosis y el esquema no se indican. La medida de resultado principal no se indica; el registro enumera como objetivos la eficacia de la radiación preoperatoria y si el ultrasonido de contraste con microburbujas puede reemplazar la biopsia quirúrgica del ganglio centinela.
who_for: Women 18 or older with invasive breast cancer 3 cm or less and node negative (T1-T2 cN0).
Estrogen or progesterone receptor positive and HER2 negative tumor.
Tumor does not involve the overlying skin.
No surgery, endocrine therapy, or chemotherapy for the current breast cancer.
Tumor visible on CT or MRI, or marked with a clip.
not_for: Prior radiation to the involved breast or prior breast cancer on the same side.
